name: THOR
summary: Tactical Hazardous Operations Robot — a lightweight electric humanoid built by Virginia Tech's RoMeLa (with UPenn and others) for the DARPA Robotics Challenge, using series-elastic and liquid-cooled actuators. Variants THOR and THOR-OP competed in the DRC and seeded RoMeLa's later work toward ARTEMIS.
notable: US university DRC entry with compliant electric actuation
